channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran, protests, human rights – all to know about the 76th FIFA Congress
item.description: The pre-World Cup congress will be headlined by geopolitical tensions, human rights concerns and logistical issues.

item.title: US military equipment worth billions of dollars destroyed in Iran war
item.description: The United States lost aerial equipment worth up to $2.8bn, according to a US-based think tank.

item.title: Why are Western feminists silent on the war on Iranian women?
item.description: Those who backed Iranian women’s protests against compulsory hijab are silent as those same women are killed.

item.title: $25bn or $1 trillion: How much has Iran war really cost the US?
item.description: Heated exchange on Capitol Hill reflects growing unease among lawmakers over a lack of transparency in cost of Iran war.

item.title: Russia has given Iran something more important than weapons
item.description: Russia's political backing and objection to escalation have proved much more consequential in shaping the conflict.

item.title: Tracking the shadow fleet: How Iran evaded the US naval blockade in Hormuz
item.description: Iran's shadow fleet uses fake flags and dark ships to evade the US naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Will the Iran war reshape the global energy order?
item.description: As oil markets shift, OPEC's grip is under pressure, US exports rise, and China drives the push towards renewables.

item.title: Oil price hits highest since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

item.title: Trump says US studying troop cuts in Germany, as spat with Merz intensifies
item.description: His remarks come after the German chancellor criticised the US approach to the war in Iran.

item.title: Israel intercepts Gaza flotilla near Crete and detains 175 activists
item.description: Pro-Palestinian activists say 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza were illegally intercepted in international waters near the Greek island.
